note: Inventory and commerce-operations software for small online sellers, founded in 2020 by Adii Pienaar (WooCommerce's co-founder); UK-registered (COGSY LIMITED, dissolved April 2026). BCV joined the Accel-led seed of December 2021 (the firm's post; Tech.eu). 'Cogsy was acquired by Mayple in 2023' (Wikipedia, Adii Pienaar) with no later round, which ends the S2A window: not graduated. Sibling Accel reads defunct and US without a citation.

Adaptive Innovations, an AI-native home-health provider (New York City and Dallas, per Home Health Care News). BCV's listing: 2025, Seed (Christina Melas-Kyriazi, Ryan Kim), at the $10M seed the company disclosed with its Series A. 'The Series A round was led by Felicis, with significant participation from Bain Capital Ventures' ($50M, June 2026), which graduates it. Not the Adaptive Security row ('adaptive'), which the firm's CMS also titles 'Adaptive'.

Online retailer (Eden Prairie; formerly Fingerhut Direct Marketing). 'Bain Capital' in its 2011 S-1 means Bain Capital Venture Fund, L.P. and affiliates; the company was sold to Capmark Financial in 2014 and later to Chinese investors. The firm's position dates from the February 2004 recapitalisation of Fingerhut (Wikipedia lists 'Bain Capital Ventures (2004)' among its owners); no source read names the round or the stake, so the stage is undetermined.
